messages.subject: Uncertainty in spatially predicted covariates
parts:
Hi, everybody

My goal is doing a map but I have data only in some locations. If I want to predict of the response variable (gaussian), how can I do that if I haven't got the covariate's values in all the locations in which I want to predict? I have been thinking in doing a kriging per covariate but if I do that, how can incorporate the uncertainty in my model? Anyway I think I can do that better.

Thank you

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Uncertainty in spatially predicted covariates
parts:
There should be an example of this in the spde tutorial. It'll be called something like "joint prediction" and it will use inla's "copy" mechanism. It works really well and I think it's quite cool!
